lines: The Roost's big vultures are down. Next comes Old Bonebeak, who nests among the ribcages.
Kill Old Bonebeak at the Boneyard Roost and bring his plume to Egle Barthrone in Agauton.

quests.name: The Trappers' Camp
quests.lore: Hobb Rusk's shipping ledger can explain where the trappers send their captive spiders.

quests.name: A Line in the Water
quests.lore: The boats have been coming back light, and the fishery on Plymouth Wharf has a counter to keep stocked.

quests.name: Nobody Came Back
quests.lore: Sergeant Ilsa Varne of the Underleaf watch sent two scouts into the orc compound north of the hollow. Neither returned.

quests.name: Pumpkins for Market
quests.lore: Wanted: six pumpkins for my market stall. Farmers grow them now, from seed off ogre elders, chargers and butchers and off withered husks. Or buy them on the Exchange. I pay at the stall. (Mange Williams)

quests.name: Nothing Gets Through
quests.lore: A slide shut the gold mine out in the Wastelands. The only man still trying to open it is working with tools that gave up on him years ago.

quests.name: Giants at the Edge
quests.lore: Young hill giants are pushing out of the valley southeast of Underleaf. The watch pays for eight. Report to me by this board. (Sergeant Ilsa Varne, Underleaf watch)

quests.name: Imp Menace
quests.lore: Imps are stealing from the market stall. Help us by defeating them.

quests.name: Silk Order
quests.lore: Wanted: eight lengths of spider silk. The giant spiders in the Rustpick Mine spin it. Paid on delivery at my shop in Binxonia. (The Tailor)

quests.name: Iron for the Forge
quests.lore: The smiths at the Mining Trainer's stall use iron faster than anyone brings it in.

quests.name: Hides Before the Frost
quests.lore: Linnet Birch makes quivers and bow grips for Underleaf's archers, and she has run out of good hide before the cold months.

quests.name: Snakes in the Reeds
quests.lore: Coral snakes in the valley southeast of Underleaf keep biting my cutting crews. Kill ten and the timber gets through. Find me at the Silver Mine. (Dace Morrow)

quests.name: Bear Meat for the Smokehouse
quests.lore: Wanted: ten cuts of bear meat to smoke for the watch's long patrols. Bears roam the woods north of Underleaf. Bring the meat to my bench. (Linnet Birch)

quests.name: Bitter Points
quests.lore: Linnet Birch wants to try coral snake venom on hunting arrows. She needs glands from the coral snakes southeast of Underleaf, and a second opinion on the result.

quests.name: Snakeskins for the Tailor
quests.lore: Wanted: eight snakeskin knicks for snakeskin work. The coral snakes in the valley southeast of Underleaf carry them. Bring them to my burrow near this board. (The Underleaf Tailor)

quests.name: The Runaways
quests.lore: Somebody left the paddock gate unlatched overnight and three of the Stablemaster's horses bolted. They won't have gone far, and they won't come back on their own either.

quests.name: Cargo for the Isle
quests.lore: The supplies bound for Ogre Isle never got there. Ogres holed up east of Underleaf took them off the road.

quests.name: An Unusual Patient
quests.lore: Tessa needs medicine and food to treat the captive wolf spider.

quests.name: A Saddle for Eight
quests.lore: The Tailor can fit a harness so the recovered wolf spider can travel with a rider.

quests.name: What Jill Knows
quests.lore: Jill Appleseed doesn't think the bandits taking exactly enough not to be noticed is luck. She thinks it's bookkeeping, and she wants the book.

quests.name: The Carpenter's Trade
quests.lore: Hollis Tamber patches every boat that ties up at Plymouth Wharf, and he has more hulls than hours.

quests.name: Outriders
quests.lore: Dune Raider outriders camp across the road from the Ancient Battlefield. Sergeant Bennet Vale wants to know who pays them.

quests.name: Gullet
quests.lore: Hill giant adolescents wade the shallows east of Windthorne and smash the village's fish traps. The biggest of them, Gullet, leads them there.

quests.name: Mother Sedge's Remedy
quests.lore: Copperheads out in the Wastelands have bitten two of Windthorne's reed cutters. Mother Sedge can brew an antivenom, but only from the snakes themselves.

quests.name: The Scriptorium Apprentice
quests.lore: The Wizard keeps a lectern in his tower and nobody to work it.

quests.name: Cutthroats in the Hall
quests.lore: The cutthroats in the bandit camp's main hall plan the robberies of my cider carts. I pay for eight of them. Report to me at the tavern. (Hollis Crabb)

quests.name: Jerky Weather
quests.lore: Nell Parrish wants her smoker full before the wind turns, and Marta Quill has been sitting up at night over the dry well.

quests.name: Hollis's Casks
quests.lore: Bandits in Longmeadow keep stopping Hollis Crabb's cider cart on the Plymouth road. He wants his casks back and the road made safe for the next load.

quests.name: Kesh's Tally
quests.lore: Kesh the Red's raiders took Fred Skentz's strongbox, and his ledger with it. Hal Rourke saw them go from the watchtower.

quests.name: Patching the Wagon
quests.lore: Ivy Stoke has dug the axles of the bleached wagon out of the sand and wants a wagon of her own for the Agauton road.

quests.name: What the Forest Keeps
quests.lore: Nyra Fernsong says the treants wake when the old wood is gone, not when it's cut. Corwen Ash says his logging camp eats because of that same wood, and there is no answer that satisfies them both.

quests.name: Highwaymen on the Road
quests.lore: Highwaymen have taken two horses off riders on the Longmeadow roads this month. The stable pays for three of them. Report to Wes Brooke. (Wes Brooke)

quests.name: Down the Sinkhole
quests.lore: Abel Munt's partner, Bram Kettle, went down the sinkhole into the Antlion Hive six years ago and never came up.

quests.name: The Quiet Rows
quests.lore: Bandits have been skimming the north orchard for three weeks, never enough to bring the constable, always enough to notice. Jack Appleseed wants it answered with steel.

quests.name: The Broken Hammers
quests.lore: Hester Bell's tools are turning up in Rustpick with their handles broken. The goblins have a use for the iron and no use for the smith who made it.

quests.name: A Road Nobody Rides
quests.lore: Wispmeyer's supply wagons stopped coming after the last driver came back with the canvas cut open and wouldn't say why. Gregor Sr. wants the down road ridden and whatever's on it dealt with.

quests.name: The White Mare
quests.lore: A white mare has run loose on the down since the winter she came through Wispmeyer wearing a saddle and no rider. The Stablemaster wants her in his paddock before the harpies bring her down.

quests.name: Three Missing Clutches
quests.lore: Three handlers hold the stolen egg clutches. Tessa needs all three back.

quests.name: Missing in the Mine
quests.lore: Silk merchant Perrin Vale went into Rustpick Mine to inspect a shipment and never returned.

quests.name: The Hollow Loom
quests.lore: Sorn the Loomkeeper holds Tessa's equipment beneath his workshop.

quests.name: Drel's Maps
quests.lore: The Thak have built a scout outpost under the mountains west of Agauton. Sergeant Idony Marsh wants to see what their scouts have been drawing.

quests.name: Goats on the Rock
quests.lore: The wolf pack at Alpha's Rock has been carrying off Trevor Barthrone's goats, and Old Ironjaw leads it.

quests.name: Sandmaw
quests.lore: Sandmaw, the old rock scorpion of the Scorpion Pits, stung Layla Barthrone's son, and her antivenom won't touch it.

quests.name: Feathers for the Clothier
quests.lore: Wanted: twelve harpy flight feathers, long and unbroken, for feathered caps. The harpies on Willow Downs carry them. Paid at the tailor's shop on the north row. (Isolde Fairweather, Clothier)

quests.name: The Ogre Traitor
quests.lore: The shipment was meant for the Ogres on Ogre Isle and one of their own took it. They call him the Traitor for that, and they want him dead before anything else crosses.

quests.name: Salt Tax
quests.lore: Varra Sunstrike's marauders took Agauton's salt tax off Wilson Barthrone's cart, and her buyers come for it within the hour.

quests.name: Saltblade
quests.lore: With Varra dead, the raiders on the flats answer to Khadim Saltblade, who pays them from a Thak purse at the Dune Raider Stronghold.

quests.name: The Muster Roll
quests.lore: With the raiders unpaid, the Thak have pushed a second scout camp into the Boneyard. Its warden carries the army's muster roll.

quests.name: The Unburied
quests.lore: The Barthrones buried their dead in Wraithhollow until the dead stopped staying down. Morvaine the Pale carries the family's grave token, and Wilson Barthrone wants it back.

quests.name: Old Bonebeak
quests.lore: Egle Barthrone fletches her bolts with vulture quill, and the vultures of the Boneyard Roost have been taking Trevor's young goats.

objectives.text: Bring Egle Barthrone Old Bonebeak's plume

p.message: Here's your pay, with Trevor's bounty in it. He says his goats are grateful. I doubt the goats noticed.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: That's his. Look at the length of it.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: It's far too good for fletching. I'll wear it.
